title: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love reportedly expected to play in season opener after dealing with high-ankle sprain

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love reportedly expected to play in season opener after dealing with high-ankle sprain
sources.description: Love's officially "questionable" for Week 1, but it sounds like there's a good chance he makes his regular-season debut against the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday.
